sections.text: The job queue is Postgres-backed now instead of Redis. Same enqueue API, same worker code, same retry semantics.
sections.thin: We have made a number of fairly substantial changes to the way the background job processing side of things works, which should have a generally positive effect on the overall reliability of that part of the platform going forward.

sections.text: Live in production since Thursday 09:00. Redis is still running but nothing writes to it; we will turn it off on the 28th.
If you enqueue jobs, drop the priority argument — it is ignored now and the parameter disappears next week.
sections.thin: There are a couple of small things to be aware of on your side.

sections.text: If you are on call, watch the jobs_pending gauge rather than the Redis list length. The old panel is already showing zero and that is expected.
We were paying for two sources of truth, and we lost jobs whenever Redis evicted under memory pressure — four times in the last quarter, twice silently.
